groups.title: Any framework
groups.text: One runtime mounts the components of every framework on the islands PAD writes - React, Vue, Svelte, Preact and Solid on one page, each fetched only when an island of it is there.

groups.title: Built with Vite
groups.text: The components are compiled by Vite and linked by {vite}: the build in production, the dev server with hot reload while it runs.

examples.title: Five frameworks, one page
examples.lede: The same counter written five times - React, Vue, Svelte, Preact and Solid - each an island with its start value from PAD, and beside it what its framework cost in bytes, read from the build's manifest.

examples.title: Load when it is needed
examples.lede: data-load says when an island's code is fetched: at once, when the browser is idle, or when it scrolls into view. The log says when each one came.

examples.title: Three frameworks, one cart
examples.lede: A React shelf, a Vue summary and a Svelte badge share one store; adding posts to PAD, which keeps the cart in the session and answers it to all three.

examples.title: Typed props
examples.lede: The island is TypeScript, and the type of its props is written by pad types from the page's own data: the order the PHP makes, captured as the page's sample. A field the PHP does not have fails the check, not the visitor.

examples.title: From source to page
examples.lede: What {vite 'src/main.js'} writes for this request and why: the manifest the build left, the chunks of each island, and the dev server that takes over while it runs.
